name: trial-booking
description: Trial class booking: parents book and pay for a 4-seat trial class, staff see the roster. Handles duplicates, overbooking, payment failure and the last-seat race.

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run db:start && npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n sandbox,api,worker,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @trial-booking/payments-sandbox" "npm run dev -w @trial-booking/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @trial-booking/api" "npm run dev -w @trial-booking/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @trial-booking/payments-sandbox && npm run build -w @trial-booking/api && npm run build -w @trial-booking/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @trial-booking/api
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
